basic_details.short_information: Three posts of Member in the Child Welfare Committees of Ariyalur District (1) and Tiruvannamalai District (2) are to be filled under the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015. The Department of Children Welfare and Special Services, Government of Tamil Nadu, invites applications by post to The Director, Directorate of Children Welfare and Special Services, Egmore, Chennai. Filled applications must reach that office on or before 5.00 P.M. on 22 December 2026. The appointment is on an honorarium basis and is not a Government employment.

age_limit.details: The applicant should not be less than 35 years of age and should not have completed 65 years on the date of notification, 23 November 2026. No age relaxation is mentioned in the notice.

qualification.details: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts. | An applicant must meet one of these two conditions: | A degree in Child Psychology or Psychiatry or Law or Social Work or Sociology or Human Health or Education or Human Development or Special Education for differently abled children, and active involvement in health, education or welfare activities pertaining to children for seven years; OR Be a practising professional with a degree in Child Psychology or Psychiatry or Law or Social Work or Sociology or Human Health or Education or Human Development or Special Education for differently abled children. | The seven years of involvement with children belong to the first option only. For the detailed eligibility, see the official notification and the application format. | The applicant should not be less than 35 years of age and should not have completed 65 years on the date of notification, 23 November 2026. No age relaxation is mentioned in the notice. | Members are appointed by the Government on an honorarium basis; the notice does not print the amount. The position is not a Government employment. No person shall be appointed for a period of more than three years as a member of the Committee. Of the Chairperson and Members appointed, one shall be a woman.

selection_process: The appointment will be purely based on merit and experience. The decision of the Government will be final in this regard. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.
important_instructions: Failure to furnish any details and proof called for in the application will result in disqualification. If the details given are found false later, legal action will be initiated and the appointment will be terminated, as stated in the declaration. Applicants in full-time employment (Government, quasi-government, public sector, private sector or NGO) must give the details in the form. The form asks applicants to disclose any record of violation of human rights or child rights, dismissal from government service, child abuse or child labour, arrests, pending criminal cases, convictions involving moral turpitude, insolvency and any office in a political party. Applicants must declare any link with a Child Care Institution or other conflict of interest, earlier service in a Juvenile Justice Board, Child Welfare Committee or District Child Protection Unit, and whether they or family members are applying for JJB or CWC in the same or other districts under this notification. The District Collector concerned has also issued a press release in the dailies about this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application format and eligibility criteria may be obtained from the District Child Protection Unit, or applicants can visit the departmental website https://dsdcpimms.tn.gov.in . The same application format is also attached to the notice. Send the filled application to this address: The Director, Directorate of Children Welfare and Special Services, No 1A, 1st floor, CMDA Tower – II, Gandhi Irwin Road, Egmore, Chennai – 600 008 The notice says the filled applications should reach the above office within the stipulated date, that is on or before 5.00 P.M. on 22 December 2026. The mode of posting (speed post, registered post or by hand) is not specified in the notice. The application form asks for: The name of the district for which the application is submitted, and the position applied for (Chairperson / Member / Both). Name, permanent address and present address, each with address proof. Age and date of birth with proof, gender, and a passport size photograph affixed on the form. Telephone, mobile and email details (office and personal). Educational and additional qualifications, experience with children's health, education or welfare work, and practice as a professional, each with proof. Answers to the declaration questions (employment, conflict of interest, criminal record and others), a write-up of not more than 100 words, and the signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts. An applicant must meet one of these two conditions: A degree in Child Psychology or Psychiatry or Law or Social Work or Sociology or Human Health or Education or Human Development or Special Education for differently abled children, and active involvement in health, education or welfare activities pertaining to children for seven years; OR Be a practising professional with a degree in Child Psychology or Psychiatry or Law or Social Work or Sociology or Human Health or Education or Human Development or Special Education for differently abled children. The seven years of involvement with children belong to the first option only. For the detailed eligibility, see the official notification and the application format. The applicant should not be less than 35 years of age and should not have completed 65 years on the date of notification, 23 November 2026. No age relaxation is mentioned in the notice. Members are appointed by the Government on an honorarium basis; the notice does not print the amount. The position is not a Government employment. No person shall be appointed for a period of more than three years as a member of the Committee. Of the Chairperson and Members appointed, one shall be a woman.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The form says the applicant must enclose copies of all supporting documents. The documents named in the form are: Address proof for permanent and present address: Aadhaar card, Voter ID or Ration Card Proof of age and date of birth Proof of educational qualification and of any additional qualifications Proof of experience in health, education or welfare activities pertaining to children Proof of practice, for applicants who are practising professionals Proof of awards, medals and certificates received, if any No-objection certificate, if the applicant is in full-time employment and the employer has agreed to spare the applicant A write-up of not more than 100 words on the applicant's suitability to hold the position and vision about the Child Welfare Committee

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The appointment will be purely based on merit and experience. The decision of the Government will be final in this regard. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TN CWC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 Member posts: 1 in the Ariyalur District Child Welfare Committee and 2 in the Tiruvannamalai District Child Welfare Committee.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CWC Member posts?
faq.answer: Filled applications must reach the Directorate of Children Welfare and Special Services, Chennai, on or before 5.00 P.M. on 22 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for a Child Welfare Committee Member?
faq.answer: A degree in Child Psychology, Psychiatry, Law, Social Work, Sociology, Human Health, Education, Human Development or Special Education for differently abled children with seven years' active involvement in children's health, education or welfare activities, or being a practising professional with such a degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the TN CWC Member post?
faq.answer: The applicant should not be less than 35 years and should not have completed 65 years on the date of notification, 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a CWC Member?
faq.answer: Members are appointed on an honorarium basis; the position is not a Government employment.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CWC Member post?
faq.answer: Get the application format from the District Child Protection Unit or https://dsdcpimms.tn.gov.in, fill it in with copies of all supporting documents, and send it to The Director, Directorate of Children Welfare and Special Services, No 1A, 1st floor, CMDA Tower – II, Gandhi Irwin Road, Egmore, Chennai – 600 008.

faq.question: Q7. How will CWC Members be selected?
faq.answer: The appointment will be purely based on merit and experience, and the decision of the Government will be final.

faq.question: Q8. For how long is a CWC Member appointed?
faq.answer: No person shall be appointed for a period of more than three years as a member of the Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Do employed applicants need a no-objection certificate?
faq.answer: Yes, if the applicant is in full-time employment and the employer has agreed to spare the applicant, the no-objection certificate must be produced with the application.
